name: d5-ai-canvas
description: Safely runs the D5 AI Canvas three-stage architectural image workflow through the local bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Run authorized D5 canvas batches from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the local D5 AI Canvas bridge for read-only folder scanning, copied-asset import, authorized three-stage runs, review cards, and safe pause or resume.
defaultPrompt: 检查 D5 AI Canvas 连接和当前项目状态。
扫描我指定的项目文件夹，并生成只读导入清单。
按已确认授权单运行 D5 三阶段画布任务。
